name: Jacks, sweetlips & grunts
description: Jacks, sweetlips and grunts - the source's 'Petit capitaine +' compartment (called 'Diagramme +' in the memoir's species table: the sweetlips Plectorhinchus macrolepis, the grunts Galeoides decadactylus and Brachydeuterus auritus, a puffer, a seabass and a surgeonfish) together with its 'Carangues' compartment (the bumper Chloroscombrus chrysurus, two Caranx jacks, a pompano and Hemicaranx). Both are zooplankton-and-shrimp-feeding mid-water schools of the turbid creek. Functional group pooling those two source compartments to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
